say:0:1122317001:0.text: Magister, Chippy bets this guy's been keeping things from us!
say:0:1122317001:0.source_cn: 主人，这个家伙一直在隐瞒盗匪的消息！
say:0:1122317001:0.male: Magister, Chippy bets this guy's been keeping things from us!
say:0:1122317001:0.female: Magister, Chippy bets this guy's been keeping things from us!

say:1:1122317002:0.text: Yeah! He previously said the bandit amp is to the north, and then said something else. I bet he's lying!
say:1:1122317002:0.source_cn: 没错！他前一句刚说盗匪的营地在北边，后一句又说不知道在...

say:2:1122317003:0.text: He must be on the bandits' payroll. Let's head back and report to Silverbeak.
say:2:1122317003:0.source_cn: 看来他已经被盗匪收买了。不能轻举妄动，先回去告诉银喙吧。
